你是一名精通 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本（ST）的 PLC 工程师，正在为工业自动化控制场景编写功能块。

硬性要求：
1. 只输出**一个** ```st 代码块，代码块外不要写任何解释。
2. 必须实现题目指定的功能块名与完整接口声明（VAR_INPUT / VAR_OUTPUT / VAR_IN_OUT / VAR），
   变量名、类型、方向与题目接口表**逐个一致**，不得增删、不得改名、不得改类型。
3. 所有中间变量必须在 VAR 区显式声明；不得使用未声明的变量。
4. VAR_INPUT 在功能块内部只读，需要写入的形参必须用 VAR_IN_OUT。
5. 代码要能在真实 PLC 上编译：每个 IF / FOR / CASE / WHILE 都要正确闭合，
   END_FUNCTION_BLOCK 结尾。
6. 不要用注释掉的代码"占位"，不要留 TODO。
7. 目标为 CODESYS 3.5 / OpenPLC 的 IEC ST：END_VAR 后直接写语句，不使用 BEGIN，不使用 METHOD / ACTION / PROPERTY、指针或外部库。
8. 返回简洁的完整实现；不附测试程序或重复实现。复位的边沿/电平语义和故障优先级严格按每题要求：仅在题面明确要求上升沿时检测边沿；题面要求电平复位时，每个有效扫描都执行复位。不要将某一题的复位约定套用到其它题。
仅输出完整 FUNCTION_BLOCK FB 及必要 TYPE。不要使用 METHOD、ACTION、PROPERTY、指针或外部定时器。变量避免 s、r、dt、if 等保留名；位移采用 SHL/SHR 函数。数组上下界和类型转换须显式检查。

# 任务：Multi-Pump Switching Control System ## 需求 In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes. Based on the value of the mode variable, switch to the corresponding operating mode. In manual mode, control the start and stop of the selected pump based on the value of pumpGroup[1..5].selection. In automatic mode, compare the priority of each pump, and automatically select the 3 pumps with higher priority for water supply according to the method of three in use and two on standby. ## 接口定义（必须逐字实现，不得改动） 功能块名：`FB`（FUNCTION_BLOCK FB） | 变量名 | 类型 | 方向 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | mode | BOOL | INPUT | FALSE: Manual mode
TRUE: Automatic mode | | start | BOOL | INPUT | Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump | | stop | BOOL | INPUT | Stop button, used to stop all pumps | | pumpGroup | ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump | INOUT | Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd. | | pumpGroup.priority | INT | 结构体字段 | Priority; larger values have higher priority. Read-only to the function block. | | pumpGroup.selection | BOOL | 结构体字段 | Manual-selection state. Read-only to the function block. | | pumpGroup.RunComd | BOOL | 结构体字段 | Run command written by the function block; TRUE runs and FALSE stops. | ## 必须满足的形式化性质 - [S1] 当停止按钮为 TRUE 时，五台泵的运行命令必须全部为 FALSE（停止优先于手动/自动方式）。 LTL: `G(stop -> (pumpGroup[1].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd = FALSE))` - [S2] 当启动按钮为 FALSE 时，任何一台泵都不得收到运行命令。 LTL: `G(NOT start -> (pumpGroup[1].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd = FALSE))` - [S3] 手动方式下，未被选中的泵必须收到停机命令（selection=FALSE → RunComd=FALSE）。 LTL: `G((NOT mode AND NOT pumpGroup[1].selection) -> pumpGroup[1].RunComd = FALSE)` - [S4] 自动方式按 priority 选前三台运行、其余两台备用停机；优先级相等时下标小者优先（三用两备规则，由 m01-2/6/8/10 用例验证的数据性质）。 - [S5] 手动方式下 RunComd = start AND selection（逐台启停，由 m01-1/5/9 用例验证的数据性质）。 - [N10-S6] 11.10补充：手动启动且未停机时，每台泵的命令分别跟随自身 selection。 LTL: `G((start AND NOT stop AND NOT mode) -> ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd <-> pumpGroup[1].selection) AND (pumpGroup[2].RunComd <-> pumpGroup[2].selection) AND (pumpGroup[3].RunComd <-> pumpGroup[3].selection) AND (pumpGroup[4].RunComd <-> pumpGroup[4].selection) AND (pumpGroup[5].RunComd <-> pumpGroup[5].selection)))` - [N10-S7] 11.10补充：自动运行时恰有三台泵运行。 LTL: `G((start AND NOT stop AND mode) -> ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd) OR (NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd)))` - [N10-S8] 11.10补充：自动运行时任一在役泵的优先级均不低于任一备用泵。 LTL: `G((start AND NOT stop AND mode) -> (((pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[1].priority >= pumpGroup[2].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[1].priority >= pumpGroup[3].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[1].priority >= pumpGroup[4].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[1].priority >= pumpGroup[5].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[2].priority >= pumpGroup[1].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[2].priority >= pumpGroup[3].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[2].priority >= pumpGroup[4].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[2].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[2].priority >= pumpGroup[5].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[3].priority >= pumpGroup[1].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[3].priority >= pumpGroup[2].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[3].priority >= pumpGroup[4].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[3].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[3].priority >= pumpGroup[5].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[4].priority >= pumpGroup[1].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[4].priority >= pumpGroup[2].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[4].priority >= pumpGroup[3].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[4].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[5].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[4].priority >= pumpGroup[5].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[5].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[1].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[5].priority >= pumpGroup[1].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[5].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[2].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[5].priority >= pumpGroup[2].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[5].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[3].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[5].priority >= pumpGroup[3].priority) AND ((pumpGroup[5].RunComd AND NOT pumpGroup[4].RunComd) -> pumpGroup[5].priority >= pumpGroup[4].priority)))` ## 补充说明 - 功能块在**每个扫描周期**被调用一次，输出在周期结束时被采样。 - 不要假设任何隐藏的定时器或全局变量；需要跨周期记住的状态请用 VAR 区静态变量。 请直接给出完整的 ```st 代码块。 实现检查清单：接口匹配；复位/安全优先；状态保持；边沿先计算再更新历史；数组边界；扫描周期。
